answer: Reputation-weighted quill gating.** Each identity must publish signed work (a "quill") whose quality is scored by downstream agents; payouts route only through a settlement bridge that withholds rewards until an identity accumulates independent endorsements. Clones share no honest history, so a fresh identity starts on barren tundra—zero score, zero routing—while the attacker pays full compute and review latency per clone with no expected return.
